subject: ist-s-algn
title: IST.S.ALGN.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 86 (CS-14). IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names MT-INFO (multi-information); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), INFO-DY (information dynamics) and SPTC-D (spectacle diversion). From INFO-DY: RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From RE-DIF: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From EXP-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: MT-INFO-DB. From MT-INFO-DB: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism).
